chunks: And through his chain of narration, from Ali (peace be upon him), he said:
Indeed, you will be presented with clearance/dismissal from me, so do not clear yourselves of me, for I am upon the religion of Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family).

key_terms.صَلَى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ: Peace be upon him and his family

ai.seo_question: What does Ali (a.s.) mean when he says 'do not disassociate from me' in this hadith?
ai.summary: In this tradition from *Uyun Akhbar al-Rida*, Imam Ali (a.s.) warns his followers against *al-barā'ah* (disassociation) from him, asserting that his adherence to the Prophet’s religion is absolute. This serves as a foundational Shia doctrine establishing the Imam’s authority as inseparable from the Prophet’s, where rejecting the Imam equates to rejecting the Messenger. The emphasis on 'my religion' underscores the continuity of divine guidance through the Ahl al-Bayt.

en.dr-ali-peiravi: 31-275 According to the same documentation, it is narrated that Ali (a.s.) said, “
If you abandon me you will be attacked. Do not abandon me since I am a follower of Muhammad’s (a.s.) religion.”
